slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

variant.description: The visual variant of the conversation list. - 'default' – shows avatar, title, preview, timestamp, and unread badge. - 'compact' – shows only a small unread indicator, the title, and an actions button.

slotDescriptions.item: The component that renders the item.
slotDescriptions.itemActions: The component that renders the item actions.
slotDescriptions.itemAvatar: The component that renders the item avatar.
slotDescriptions.itemContent: The component that renders the item content.
slotDescriptions.preview: The component that renders the preview.
slotDescriptions.root: The component that renders the root.
slotDescriptions.scrollbar: The component that renders the scrollbar.
slotDescriptions.scrollbarThumb: The component that renders the scrollbar thumb.
slotDescriptions.scroller: The component that renders the scroller.
slotDescriptions.timestamp: The component that renders the timestamp.
slotDescriptions.title: The component that renders the title.
slotDescriptions.unreadBadge: The component that renders the unread badge.
slotDescriptions.viewport: The component that renders the viewport.
